consumer: An engine dialogue/condition u_has_items check that asks: does the avatar actor have at least 30 rounds of 9mm on-person (the boolean the engine returns).
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory) on their person
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its lambda returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count), an engine-computed yes/no over the character actor, which is the predicate authority rather than a re-count of the snapshot.
divergence: Avatar carries exactly 30 rounds of 9mm but split as 20 loose plus 10 merged into a worn ammo-container/speedloader (the i_add_to_container path): has_charges/has_amount returns true, while a raw per-item scan of carried_items[] that ignores count_by_charges and container contents undercounts and wrongly answers no.
